title: GTCC Aviation Center Expansion
lastAction: Ref to the Com on Appropriations, if favorable, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill appropriates $1.8 million in state funds to Guilford Technical Community College for expanding its Aviation Center and related capital expenses, effective July 1, 2026. The funds are nonrecurring and will remain available until spent.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this expansion improves workforce development in aviation, a growing industry sector in North Carolina. They contend that enhancing GTCC's aviation program increases access to career training, helps fill employer demand for skilled aviation technicians, and supports economic growth in the Greensboro region.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether this is the best use of limited state education dollars and whether the timing is appropriate given other budget priorities. Some might argue that the state should evaluate whether existing facilities can be better utilized first, or whether private industry should contribute more funding to support workforce training that benefits their own hiring needs.
